title: /api/report-screenshot-upload
responsibility: Accepts a same-origin screenshot pair and preserves storage, image and report-state failure responses.

inputs.name: POST.request
inputs.description: Required incoming HTTP request, admitted before reading multipart data.

inputs.name: POST.url
inputs.description: Required server-resolved URL; its origin defines the accepted upload origin.

outputs.name: POST
outputs.description: A 201 JSON report on success, or an explicit JSON admission, media, report-state or storage error response. Parsing/storage exceptions are translated into responses.
